questions.question: What does Moses urge Israel to do in chapter 4?
options: Build a great temple in the new land
Obey God's laws and not forget the covenant
Offer daily sacrifices on every hill
Choose a king to rule over all of the tribes
questions.answer: Obey God's laws and not forget the covenant

questions.question: Why were they to make no idols?
options: They saw no form of God at Sinai, only heard his voice
The surrounding nations would mock their carved gods
The gold had all been used for the tabernacle
No craftsman among them was skilled enough to make one
questions.answer: They saw no form of God at Sinai, only heard his voice

questions.question: Moses warned them not to add to or take away from God's commands.
Israel was to watch themselves closely, lest they _____ the things their eyes had seen.
Moses said the LORD spoke to them out of the midst of the _____ at Horeb.
